label: Diagram 2.38
caption: Diagram 2.38 Wall type 4 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf
description: A plan headed "Diagram 2.38 Wall type 4 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf", marked "PLAN" at the lower right. The external wall runs vertically on the left: an outer leaf of masonry blocks with single diagonal hatching, a cavity, and a timber frame inner leaf filled with insulation drawn as loops. The separating wall, two timber frames each with a lining on its outer face and a gap between them, runs off to the right; where it meets the external wall, insulation (loops) fills the gap between the frames. Two cross-hatched blocks in the cavity, one at each frame of the separating wall, are labelled "Cavity stops".
